name: Joint Reconstruction and Motion Compensation via Differentiable Projector
aliases: Joint Cone-Beam CT Reconstruction and Rigid Motion Compensation Using A Differentiable Projector
Joint Image Reconstruction and Motion Estimation
definition: A joint image reconstruction and motion estimation framework that integrates rigid motion compensation directly into a model-based iterative reconstruction (MBIR) scheme. It uses a projection-domain data fidelity objective coupled with a differentiable forward projector to enable gradient-based optimization of both the attenuation volume and motion parameters simultaneously.
summary: Joint Reconstruction and Motion Compensation via Differentiable Projector solves motion artifacts in Cone-Beam CT by jointly estimating volume and motion parameters using analytical gradients from a differentiable forward projector, avoiding expensive volume warping.
